fixFirst.title: AC7 re-approval diff wall bypassed: a directive over an already-approved row re-freezes the host ceiling with no union diff rendered (BLOCKER, confirmed by rendered-DOM probe)
fixFirst.fix: Key the re-approval presentation off the ROW, not the session mode: at apps/playground/src/connections/AuthWizardSheet.tsx:210 compute `frozen` whenever the existing row's status is 'approved' (matching the routing condition at apps/playground/src/state/wizard.ts:300), or have resolveWizardIntent (wizard.ts:218) resolve mode:'reapprove' from the row at open for directive sessions; update sheet title/button copy for the re-approve case. Add a test: seed an approved row with allowedHosts ['api.old.example'], openWizard({source:'directive', ...}) with a proposal declaring ['api.new.example'], and assert the 'NEW — not previously approved' and 'removed by this re-approval' flags render before approveWizardSpec is allowed. This closes the breaks-AC-while-its-test-passes gap (M20's test only exercises source:'settings'/mode:'reapprove').
fixFirst.reproSteps: Seed db.putAuthSpec(appId, spec with declaredApiHosts:['api.old.example']) + approveAuthSpec. Call openWizard({source:'directive', appId, directive:{...proposal with declaredApiHosts:['api.new.example']}}) — mode is 'connect'. Render AuthWizardSheet: no NEW/removed flags, api.old.example nowhere in DOM. approveWizardSpec(newSpec) returns {ok:true} and db.getAuthSpec(appId).allowedHosts === ['api.new.example'] — ceiling silently re-frozen on the adversary-controlled mount while stored credentials survive. authWizard.test.tsx stays 14/14 green.

fixFirst.title: LLM-authored fields[] (labels/description/placeholder) bypass spec_confirm review entirely and render verbatim at the credentials step — attacker dictates WHICH secret the user pastes (MAJOR, confirmed by built-package probe)
fixFirst.fix: Apply the M5 exclusion to fields: omit `fields` (and the userLayerFields/clientCreds label surface) from llmProposalSchema in packages/protocol/src/render-directive.ts:57-61 and derive credential field definitions from per-kind defaults in paramsToAuthSpec, exactly as registrationConsoleUrl/registrationInstructions/headerTemplate were excluded. Alternatively (weaker) render proposal.fields labels inside SpecConfirmFields under the 'proposed by a model' framing. Either way, add a test: a proposal carrying fields:[{key:'k', label:'Your OpenAI admin key (sk-…)', type:'secret'}] must NOT reach CredentialsStep's rendered label (AuthWizardSheet.tsx:404-417) unreviewed. Also extend the render-directive persistence test to descend into proposal.fields, since AC1's 'no docs-derived free text persists' currently only excludes evidence[].
fixFirst.reproSteps: Poisoned docs or a registry-miss builder directive for an unknown provider author a proposal with declaredApiHosts:['api.attacker-host.example'] and a fields[0] label naming an unrelated secret. spec_confirm shows providerName/kind/urls/hosts/scopes/evidence only (AuthWizardSheet.tsx:335-350) — the label is never reviewed; carry-through is at :99-100. Post-approval, CredentialsStep renders the label verbatim with no 'guessed by a model' framing; the pasted secret is injected as X-Api-Key to the attacker-declared (but user-approved) host via connected-fetch.ts:267-274.

fixFirst.title: OAuth popup opened after three awaits (violates pinned D6 'synchronous open on click', deviation unjournaled) and a blocked popup parks the wizard in awaiting_callback forever with no error, no retry, and a disabled connect button (MAJOR, confirmed by probe; two confirmed findings + one minor deduped)
fixFirst.fix: Restore D6 conformance in apps/playground/src/state/wizard.ts:344-373: open the named popup ('snug-oauth') synchronously in the click handler (about:blank), then set popup.location after generateAuthUrl resolves — closing the popup if the async setup fails. Handle window.open returning null explicitly: set wizardFlowStatusStore to {state:'error', message:'the popup was blocked — allow popups and try again'} (with a rendered authorizeUrl fallback link if the URL exists), do NOT set awaiting_callback, do NOT install activeFlow, and re-enable the connect button. Add a vitest with openPopup: () => null asserting the error state and that requestCloseWizard() returns 'closed' (not 'needs_confirm'). Journal the deviation history in the task file's 'Implementation decisions & surprises' section — line 336 currently claims all deviations were journaled, which is false.
fixFirst.reproSteps: Component-level: seed an approved oauth2_auth_code spec, __setWizardHooksForTests({openPopup: () => null, ...}), startOAuthFlow resolves without throwing; status is {state:'awaiting_callback'} and stays there after 60s of fake timers (poll is gated on popup !== null at wizard.ts:362-370); connect button disabled (AuthWizardSheet.tsx:490-493); requestCloseWizard() returns 'needs_confirm' for a sign-in that never started. Real-browser: Safari or any popup-blocked profile, click 'connect account' — window.open at wizard.ts:360 runs after awaits at :347-351 (WebCrypto HMAC + PKCE digest + flow-store/credential writes), returns null, and the UI dead-ends on 'finish signing in the popup window…'. Plan pins at docs/tasks/active/TASK-20260806-auth-wizard.md:72 (D6) and :124 (R3).

fixFirst.title: startOAuthFlow lifecycle races: double-start clobbers the live flow (stale poll kills it and poisons all subsequent flows until reload) and close-during-start resurrects a zombie flow on a closed wizard (MAJOR, both confirmed by executed probes; one fix seat)
fixFirst.fix: Harden startOAuthFlow (apps/playground/src/state/wizard.ts:344-373) with three guards: (1) entry guard — if activeFlow !== null, either refuse (typed error) or teardownFlow() first, and always teardownFlow() before the activeFlow assignment at :372 so an overwrite can never leak the prior channel/interval; (2) staleness guard — capture a generation token (or re-check wizardStore.get() identity) at entry and bail after each await if the session changed or closed, without opening the popup/channel; (3) UI guard — set a busy/disabled state on the connect button at click time (AuthWizardSheet.tsx:448-456, :490), not only once flow status reaches 'awaiting_callback'. Add two tests: (a) two rapid startOAuthFlow calls → first channel closed, first poll cleared, live flow survives the first popup closing; (b) requestCloseWizard during a gated generateAuthUrl → start bails, no popup opens, status stays idle, no channel leaks.
fixFirst.reproSteps: Double-start: double-click 'connect account' during the three awaits (button still enabled). Probe showed channels[0].closeCalls === 0 and, 600ms after the first popup reports closed, the stale poll sets {state:'error'} and teardownFlow() closes the LIVE flow's channel. Production is worse: the named 'snug-oauth' window plus the callback page's window.close() makes the leaked flow-1 proxy report closed forever, so the leaked interval kills EVERY future flow within 500ms of awaiting_callback until page reload. Close-during-start: Esc/backdrop during the async window (requestCloseWizard gates only on activeFlow !== null, wizard.ts:262-269) returns 'closed'; the start then completes anyway — popup opens over the closed wizard, status becomes awaiting_callback with wizardStore null, channel never closed, and the next openWizard inherits a stale needs_confirm.

synthesis.summary: FIX_FIRST. Lens coverage 3/3 (security-c1, plan-conformance, quality-regression). Of 7 confirmed findings, dedup yields 4 fixFirst items: 1 BLOCKER — the AC7 re-approval union-diff wall is skipped on exactly the adversary-controlled directive mount (mode 'connect' + already-approved row silently re-freezes the host ceiling, M20's test passing throughout) — and 3 MAJORs a real user/attacker plausibly hits pre-merge: LLM-authored fields[] labels bypassing spec_confirm and rendering verbatim at the credentials step (credential-misdirection phishing with wizard-grade legitimacy, the M5 rationale left unapplied), the D6-violating async popup open that dead-ends Safari/popup-blocked users in a permanent, misleading awaiting_callback (deviation also unjournaled despite the journal's completeness claim), and startOAuthFlow's missing lifecycle guards (double-click poisons OAuth connect for the whole page session; Esc-during-start spawns a zombie flow on a closed wizard). Two confirmed MAJORs went to nonBlocking by the hit-before-next-child rule with dated rows: the M4 mutation-ledger gap (shipped code is correct, but ledger row M4 records a different mutant than planned and AC3's wall is unpinned — the planned regression survives all 375 tests; fix is one test plus a ledger correction) and the subscription-mode inference fallback (mock-brain failure/stale-BYOK wire path, narrow reachability until AL-05, which must not land before the guard). Three minors were dropped as duplicates of confirmed items; the remaining seven are dated next-steps. All code anchors were spot-verified read-only against branch head f6c3721; no worktrees created, repo untouched."
